name: adr183-go-check-2
scope: Full Go gate after the ADR-183 native fixes
results: One failure: internal/bootstrap TestOwnerObservationForwarderOriginalDeadlineAndJoinedClose/blocked-headers (second load-dependent occurrence; first seen as blocked-body during an earlier package run). Cause: the 250 ms original interval can elapse under -race load before the GET reaches the fixture handler, so the exact one-GET assertion fails while the forwarder behaves correctly. Fixed for adr183-go-check-3 by a 1 s interval and a 3 s elapsed bound; exactly-one-GET, at-most-one-POST and the original deadline checks are unchanged.
